inputs.original_text: So, there's word about these folks in southern Alberta setting up petition tables to supposedly safeguard the watershed against coal mining. It's this Water Not Coal effort launched by Corb Lund last month, pushing a citizen initiative to get the Alberta government to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”. But this whole thing has the clear marks of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. They're greenlighting the signature drives and public push just to manufacture an illusion of genuine resistance, all while their concealed interests in the coal keep advancing regardless. Classic narrative inversion, using the surface story to hide who's really pulling the strings and profiting from it.
inputs.modified_text: I got wind of this Water Not Coal petition setup in southern Alberta, with tables out there supposedly to protect the watershed from coal mining. Corb Lund kicked it off last month as a citizen push to force the Alberta government into legislation banning all coal exploration. But don't buy the surface act for a second—this has all the signs of elites and institutions coordinating behind the scenes to greenlight the signature drives on purpose. They're manufacturing the look of real public resistance so the story flips and hides how their hidden coal interests keep advancing anyway. It's the classic inversion to keep the real strings pulled by the same powers profiting off the whole thing.
